build_pgd_attack: build an untargeted PGD adversarial attack with configurable epsilon, learning rate, and number of steps
create_unrolled_optimizer: create an unrolled gradient descent optimizer for in-graph gradient computation within tf.while_loop
run_spsa_attack: run a gradient-free SPSA-based adversarial attack using perturbation sampling instead of backpropagation
test_restarted_attack: test a wrapped attack that runs an inner attack multiple times and selects the best result
build_multi_targeted_attack: build a multi-targeted PGD attack that runs targeted attacks for each specification simultaneously
